meta.units: unscaled unless the key says _scaled; x = S_x x_hat + c_x, u = S_u u_hat + c_u
meta.tau: normalised time in [0, 1]; node k at tau = k/(N-1); physical time is state 'time'

integrator.method: multiple shooting; all N-1 segments stacked into one ODE; A_d, B_d, C_d by forward-mode JVP through the integrator (no variational equations)
integrator.control_hold: FOH for thrust (u(tau) = u_k + (tau-tau_k)(N-1)(u_{k+1}-u_k)); ZOH for _time_dilation (u_k on the segment)
integrator.dynamics_scaling: dx/dtau = s * f(x, u) for every state, s = u[_time_dilation]
integrator.ctcs_dynamics: d y/dtau = s * sum_j max(0, g_j(x,u))^2 over all 20 ctcs constraints
integrator.sparsity_note: A_d/B_d/C_d are CVXPY Parameters with a declared sparsity pattern; the arrays here are what the subproblem used. *_raw_minus_used_maxabs reports what the pattern dropped.

warmup.note: Problem.initialize() runs one full iteration from X0/U0 (JIT warm-up); its subproblem is identical to iteration 1
